what: The closure of instratus_condensate checked on captured frames: the routine's own last lines (cldwat2m_macro.F90:1778-1801) hold to the bit, so a model that answers only the stratus fractions and in-stratus condensates and derives the rest by those lines conserves water and moist energy exactly.

checked.checker: conservation residuals per live column, relative to the column's own magnitude

water.expression: qv_out + ql_out + qi_out == qv0_in + ql0_in + qi0_in

reading: Water and moist energy close to floating-point round-off and the in-stratus products are exact: the derivation layer of a surrogate can be these four lines verbatim, and the free variables are al_st, ai_st, ql_st and qi_st.  al_st reaches 1.0 only where the cumulus fraction is zero; both are bounded by 1 - a_dc - a_sc.
